_tier: Tier A: map IDs, widths, original_life and the three bosses from v83 Map.wz / Mob.wz. Tier C: region, map order and pool rules (spec #449 C1, ticket #463, progression step 6), the 900 s duration and every pacing value, which copy Sleepywood's keyframe numbers (rate, max_alive, hp, speed), bursts, elites, exp_mult and hard_cap exactly (Sleepywood carries no post_duration_slope). Only the pools differ, and there is no opening_ramp: level_scale takes its place. Keyframes from 300 s carry no pool because map 1 picks only keyframes with t < 300 (maps 2 and 3 use their own life lists).
name: Toy Factory
_bosses: Tier C: owner schedule (Rombot, Alishar, Timer; spec #449); hp_mult, dmg_mult and attack_dmg_mult are the first draft of game/tools/level_scale_draft.gd (--step=6 --stage=ludibrium), not tuned. 8 s per-attack cadence as every boss. Canonical attacks, timing, stats and elements stay in Mob.wz. All bosses and reward choices must finish to clear.
_maps: Tier C: owner map order and pool rules, spec #449. Each boss time is relative to map entry. Map 1 is a hand-written curve pool of its own roster (Roloduck, Panda Teddy); maps 2 and 3 use their v83 life lists, which hold no timed, hidden or event entries (Zone 4: Robo and Panda Teddy; Zone 1: Master Robo only). Rombot's own Hidden Tower is a 530 px shaft and Timer's Lost Time maps are 1777 px with 11-16 ladders, so both fight in these fields; Alishar is the Ludibrium party quest's boss and has no field of its own.

_level_scale: Tier C (#463, #449 first draft): pasted from level_scale_draft.gd --step=6 --stage=ludibrium, not tuned. exp_level(t) is Sleepywood's effective level E_sw at each keyframe time, and level(t) = E_sw(t) + 3 x (6 - 5), so every region levels the character at Sleepywood's pace and this step is three effective levels harder. Without it the stage would run its canonical monsters at full strength from 0:00 for a Lv1 character.
_pools: Tier C weights (#463), map 1 only: Roloduck 3210204 (Lv34) opens alone, then Panda Teddy 3210203 (Lv36) joins at 2:00 at the same weight, the map's own two monsters in the order of their level.
